description: Carta di Localizzazione Probabile delle Valanghe (CLPV) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sirvalweb.servizirl.it. The Probable Location Charter of the Valanghe (CLPV) contains the perimeters of the areas potentially affected by avalanche phenomena. It is a thematic paper that shows the avalanche sites both detected directly, on the basis of eye and/or archival testimonies, and acquired indirectly by photo interpretation. The entire provinces are: Bergamo, Como, Sondrio, Brescia. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Map of Localisation Probable of the Valanghe (CLPV)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include neve, pzev, sirval, slavine, ptr, valanghe. The listing shows 2024-06-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
